name: antigravity-quota-lens
description: Real-time Gemini token usage, 5-hour sprint quota, and weekly limits right on your status bar.

enumDescriptions: Full: Shows both 5h and Weekly quotas with countdown timers (e.g. Gemini 5h: 88% (4h 32m) | Wk: 64% (5d 11h))
5-Hour Only: Shows only the 5-hour burst quota
Weekly Only: Shows only the weekly baseline limit
antigravityQuota.displayFormat.description: Information displayed in the status bar.

antigravityQuota.pollingInterval.description: Interval in seconds to automatically refresh quota from the Antigravity language server.

antigravityQuota.showCredits.description: Include prompt credits count in the status bar item.

antigravityQuota.statusBarPriority.description: Priority position of the status bar item (higher moves it further left within the right-aligned section).
